scheme.canonical: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted by Unicode code point; separators ',' and ':' with no whitespace; arrays keep their order
scheme.strings: the quotation mark, the reverse solidus and U+0000-U+001F are escaped (short forms for U+0008, U+0009, U+000A, U+000C, U+000D; lowercase four-digit hex for the rest); every other code point, including U+2028, U+2029, U+007F, '<', '>', '&' and characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, is written as its UTF-8 bytes
scheme.numbers: integers of magnitude at most 2^53-1, written in decimal with no sign for zero, no fraction and no exponent; any other number is outside the contract and the implementations do not agree on it (out_of_contract_number_cases)
scheme.reference: awid.signing.canonical_json_bytes: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8
scheme.value: the JSON value to encode, after parsing this file
scheme.canonical_hex: lowercase hex of the exact canonical bytes
scheme.code_point_key_order_cases: object keys whose UTF-16 code unit order differs from their code point order; every implementation reproduces every case, and one that sorts keys by UTF-16 code unit (as RFC 8785 does) does not
scheme.escaped_line_separator_cases: the escaped form: the canonical form except that U+2028 and U+2029 are written as the six ASCII characters of their lowercase escapes (reverse solidus, u, 2028 or 2029), in string values and in object keys; Go awid.CanonicalJSONValueEscapingLineSeparators writes it, for the A2A Agent Card digest and the other digests that only aw computes; card_digest, where present, is 'sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes
scheme.out_of_contract_number_cases: numbers outside the contract: json is the JSON text each implementation parses with its own parser; each implementation field is 'refused' or the lowercase hex of the bytes that implementation writes. python_canonical_json_bytes: json.loads then awid.signing.canonical_json_bytes. go_canonical_json_value: encoding/json Unmarshal into an interface value (numbers become float64) then awid.CanonicalJSONValue. go_canonical_json_value_use_number: a Decoder with UseNumber (numbers keep their text) then awid.CanonicalJSONValue. go_strict_canonical_json_use_number: a Decoder with UseNumber then awid.StrictCanonicalJSON, which refuses every float64. typescript_canonical_json_value: JSON.parse then canonicalJSONValue. These cases record behaviour; they do not define a canonical form
scheme.lone_surrogate_cases: unpaired surrogates, which are outside the contract: same fields as out_of_contract_number_cases. Python refuses to encode them, Go's parser replaces each by U+FFFD, TypeScript writes each as a six-character escape and orders a key by the surrogate's own value

cases.name: line_separator_in_string
cases.note: U+2028 in a string value is written as its three UTF-8 bytes e2 80 a8

cases.name: paragraph_separator_in_string
cases.note: U+2029 in a string value is written as its three UTF-8 bytes e2 80 a9

cases.name: line_separator_in_key
cases.note: U+2028 in an object key is written as its UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: paragraph_separator_in_key
cases.note: U+2029 in an object key is written as its UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: reverse_solidus_before_separator_text
cases.note: a reverse solidus followed by the six ASCII characters of a separator escape stays an escaped reverse solidus followed by that text; a real separator next to it is written raw

cases.name: html_characters
cases.note: less-than, greater-than and ampersand are written as themselves

cases.name: non_bmp_character
cases.note: a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane is written as its four UTF-8 bytes, not as a surrogate pair escape

cases.name: control_characters
cases.note: U+0000-U+001F are escaped: the short forms for backspace, tab, line feed, form feed and carriage return, lowercase four-digit hex for the others

cases.name: delete_and_c1_controls
cases.note: U+007F and U+0080-U+009F are written as their UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: quotation_mark_and_reverse_solidus
cases.note: the quotation mark and the reverse solidus take a reverse solidus; the solidus does not

cases.name: key_order_bmp
cases.note: keys sort by code point: uppercase before lowercase ASCII, then Latin-1, then U+2028, then U+FF5E; the empty key sorts first

cases.name: scalars_and_nesting
cases.note: booleans, null, integers up to 2^53-1 in magnitude, empty containers and nested key order

code_point_key_order_cases.name: key_order_non_bmp_after_bmp
code_point_key_order_cases.note: keys sort by code point, so U+FF5E and U+FFFD precede U+1F600; sorting by UTF-16 code unit puts U+1F600 (d83d de00) first

code_point_key_order_cases.name: key_order_non_bmp_against_u_e000
code_point_key_order_cases.note: U+D7FF, then U+E000, then U+10000; sorting by UTF-16 code unit puts U+10000 (d800 dc00) before U+E000

code_point_key_order_cases.name: key_order_non_bmp_against_u_ffff
code_point_key_order_cases.note: U+FFFF, the last code point of the Basic Multilingual Plane, precedes U+1F600 and U+10FFFF; sorting by UTF-16 code unit puts both surrogate pairs first

code_point_key_order_cases.name: key_order_non_bmp_pair
code_point_key_order_cases.note: two keys outside the Basic Multilingual Plane order by code point (U+10000, U+1F600, U+1F601, U+10FFFF), each after U+FFFD; a shared ASCII prefix does not change the order of what follows it

code_point_key_order_cases.name: key_order_non_bmp_nested
code_point_key_order_cases.note: the same order inside a nested object and inside an object held by an array

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_line_separator_in_string
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: U+2028 in a string value is written as the six ASCII characters of its lowercase escape

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_paragraph_separator_in_string
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: U+2029 in a string value is written as the six ASCII characters of its lowercase escape

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_separators_in_keys
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: U+2028 and U+2029 in object keys are written as escapes; the keys are ordered by code point, so U+2027 precedes them and U+202A follows them, which is not the order of the escaped text

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_separator_after_reverse_solidus_text
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: a reverse solidus followed by the text u2028 is an escaped reverse solidus followed by that text; the separator next to it is written as its escape

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_form_other_characters
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: every other character is written as in cases: less-than, greater-than, ampersand, U+007F and a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane as UTF-8, control characters as their escapes

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: escaped_form_code_point_key_order
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: keys are ordered by code point, as in code_point_key_order_cases

escaped_line_separator_cases.name: a2a_agent_card_with_line_separators
escaped_line_separator_cases.note: an A2A Agent Card whose description holds both separators; card_digest is sha256 over these bytes, lowercase hex

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: number_with_fraction
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: a number with a fractional part

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: integral_float
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: a number written with a fraction of zero

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: negative_zero
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: negative zero written as an integer

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: negative_zero_float
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: negative zero written with a fraction

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: exponent_form
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: an integer value written with an exponent

out_of_contract_number_cases.name: exponent_form_large
out_of_contract_number_cases.note: a value that the float formatters write with an exponent

lone_surrogate_cases.name: lone_surrogate_in_string
lone_surrogate_cases.note: an unpaired high surrogate in a string value

lone_surrogate_cases.name: lone_surrogate_in_key
lone_surrogate_cases.note: an unpaired high surrogate in an object key

lone_surrogate_cases.name: lone_surrogate_key_order
lone_surrogate_cases.note: an unpaired surrogate key next to U+D7FF, U+E000 and a surrogate pair: TypeScript orders it by its own value (U+D83D), between U+D7FF and U+E000; Go has replaced it by U+FFFD before ordering
